messages.content:
A learner of English is rewriting part of a post. The sentence they are working towards, for you only (never quote it or give it away): "a little kittypet from far away". Gloss each hint word in the sense it has in that sentence, not its most common sense ("alone" in "the clouds alone explain it" means "only", not "by oneself").

Their hint words, exactly 3: "faraway", "kittypet", "young". "a / b" is a choice between two words.

For each of these hint words and no others, in this order: piece: the hint word as given. gloss: in Simplified Chinese (as used in mainland China), what it means here and how it is used, in one or two short sentences (the kind of word, what it goes with, register if it matters; for a choice, how the two differ). example: one short, natural English sentence that uses it in the same sense, about everyday life and on a topic unrelated to the post (different people, events and subject), so it shows the word without giving away the sentence they are building.
Reply with JSON only: {"notes":[{"piece":"","gloss":"","example":""}]}

result.text: {"notes":[{"piece":"faraway","gloss":"意为“遥远的、偏远的”，指距离很远的地方。通常放在名词前作定语，如 faraway lands，语气偏书面或叙述性，比 distant 更口语化。","example":"My grandmother moved to a faraway village after she retired."},{"piece":"kittypet","gloss":"指被人家养在家里、依赖主人生活的宠物猫，与野猫或流浪猫相对。是口语词，多用于非正式场合，有时带一点亲昵或戏谑的意味。","example":"Our neighbor's kittypet spends every afternoon asleep on the windowsill."},{"piece":"young","gloss":"意为“年幼的、年纪小的”，用来说明人或动物的年龄小，修饰名词时放在名词前，如 a young cat。在这里表示年纪小，可以替代 little 的“年幼”含义。","example":"The young cashier at the bakery always remembers my order."}]}
